prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production transparent pixel-art character animation sprite sheet, not an illustration.
Input image 1 is the NEW FIXED FRONT SEATED MASTER and must be copied faithfully as the base pose in every cell; image 2 is the immutable originally approved character identity. Preserve this exact warm brown stocky tabby, fine pixel clusters, same broad face, olive-gold eyes, pink nose, cream rounded muzzle and chest, forehead M and body stripe map, same body volume, same tail silhouette. Do not redesign, simplify, change face, enlarge the eyes, or tilt the head.
Canvas contract: EXACT 2804x1122 transparent PNG, a strictly even 4 columns by 2 rows grid, exactly 8 cells, each 701x561 pixels. One complete cat per cell. No labels, borders, gutters, shadows, ground, props or text. Scale the seated reference exactly 50% within each cell; same x/y placement and same scale in every cell. Baseline at local y=540. Upright centered head, both eyes level, torso and two seated hindquarters stay in the same place. Tail stays still. FULL cat including whiskers and tail visible in every cell, no clipping.
Action: natural seated mouth grooming with ONE front paw, reading left-to-right then second row. Exactly FOUR anatomical limbs per cat: two folded hind legs with hind paws at the outer sides, one planted front leg on IMAGE RIGHT, one moving front leg on IMAGE LEFT (cat's right foreleg). The moving paw must be physically ATTACHED to its own shoulder by a single bent forearm. CRITICAL: whenever this front paw is raised, its original grounded leg and paw MUST BE ABSENT, revealing belly fur/transparent space behind it. There cannot be a stationary left front leg plus a new raised arm. Only THREE paws touch the floor in raised-paw frames, with the fourth paw visibly in the air. Do not mistake the hind paw at far image-left for the moving front paw. Never a fifth limb, fifth foot, doubled forearm, or detached paw.
Frame 1 (top left): exact seated master, both forepaws grounded, neutral level head.
Frame 2: gently shift weight onto planted IMAGE-RIGHT forepaw and hindquarters; IMAGE-LEFT forepaw just lifted one paw-height off floor, elbow begins bending. Vacate its former ground position.
Frame 3: same forepaw halfway upward at lower chest, elbow folded; original forepaw floor position empty. Head stays straight, eyes softly attentive.
Frame 4: same paw lightly touches left corner of mouth, slight forward nod ONLY, no sideways head tilt. Other three limbs remain planted.
Frame 5: same paw sweeps a small distance across muzzle toward nose, partially covering mouth, eyes gently half-close, head upright and level. No new limb.
Frame 6: paw withdraws just below muzzle at upper chest, elbow still folded, head returns to neutral level, eyes gently open.
Frame 7: paw descends toward its exact original ground position, halfway down at lower chest, same single forearm unfolds.
Frame 8 (bottom right): paw has returned to exact seated master position, body settles, gentle blink. Same four limbs and original neutral head.
This is a single non-looping 1.7 second wipe, not waving or nuzzling. Show eight genuinely distinct anatomical poses with logical paw trajectory. Stable face and body texture, stable supporting paws, no whole-image translation/rotation/squash to fake motion. Render in the approved original finely detailed pixel-art style with crisp pixels and no blurred painterly shading. Transparent alpha background.
